description: Get the pay stub PDF for each employee on a paid payroll. Returns the same stub the family downloads in the dashboard, attached as a PDF file, plus a short summary. A payroll that is not paid yet answers payroll_not_completed; check get_payroll and ask again once it is completed. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

employee_id.description: Optional. One employee's stub instead of everyone's on the payroll.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

payroll_id.description: The payroll id from run_payroll or get_payroll.

name: get_pay_stub
